players.product: PECVD (Stack ONO, ACHM hard-mask) and ALD thin-film deposition tools for 3D NAND and advanced memory, plus hybrid-bonding tools

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Lu Guangquan (H1 2026 results briefing): the built bases in Shenyang and Shanghai give annual capacity of over 700 tools, enough for current needs, and the Shenyang second plant is expected in use in 2028. General manager Liu Jing said orders on hand are full; key components use multi-source procurement with long-term strategic core suppliers, so capacity and supply chain meet current market demand, and overall product validation cycles are expected to gradually shorten as new platforms and processes mature. Asked about tight semiconductor-equipment component supply, the chairman said the company has seen no material impact so far.

Chairman Lu Guangquan (H1 2026 results briefing): PECVD Stack (ONO), ACHM-series, OPN and SiB tools keep expanding in volume production, and the company has developed and shipped new products to customers - the PF-300L platform and nX and kX reaction chambers - for the low-k dielectric film requirements of advanced-node chips. In 3D integration it has launched more than ten advanced bonding tools and matching metrology tools covering advanced memory, advanced logic, advanced packaging, image sensors and Micro-OLED, and keeps adding customers; its metrology work is limited to bonding strength and accuracy for 3D integration and it has not expanded into front-end metrology. It has won overseas customer orders and exported to overseas markets.
